weather_report:
In the quiet hours of the night, Downtown San Francisco embraces a gentle clarity, the air tinged with an expected ease. With temperatures settling into the comfortable embrace of 58 degrees, the night sky exudes a serene calm, crisp and mostly clear. As dawn approaches on this fine Thursday, sunlight will spill graciously over the bay, promising a high near 72. The gentle west-southwest breezes, not more than a whisper at times, will usher in a warm, inviting day.

With a marine layer that lingers at the bay's edge, a touch of charm graces the landscape. The fog, if present, clings tenderly to the coast, ceding its territory to the advancing sun. Residents might find themselves indulging in the simple pleasures of a leisurely morning—perhaps a walk along the Embarcadero, where the sun’s golden rays will play upon the still waters, or a visit to one of the local cafés where the aroma of fresh coffee mingles with the salty air. Dressing in layers remains wise; a light sweater for early hours will transition beautifully to the warmth of the afternoon. So, step outside and savor the unfolding day, where the sharp contours of the city draw back, offering a tableau painted by nature and the comforting rhythms of life in San Francisco.
